fi-chiloscyllium-punctatum.title: Brown Banded Bamboo Shark
fi-chiloscyllium-punctatum.summary: A bottom-dwelling bamboo shark that LiveAquaria rates expert-only.
rows: About 42 in (LiveAquaria max size); wild record 132 cm (52 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore. Start with squid or live shrimp, then shrimp, scallops and marine fish
Indo-West Pacific: Andaman Island and India east to Philippines, north to Japan and south to Australia
notes: Needs a soft sand bottom; coarse substrate scratches its belly.
warn: Eats any crustacean in the tank. Needs a very large tank as it grows.
